html: Thanks to everyone still checking in and especially to those who’ve written asking how I am. I’m good! I’ve been busy and I’ve been meaning to get a new computer and keep thinking “I’ll update when I get the new computer” but then never do either. I always have stuff I’m working on but with enough time they all look like garbage and lost causes. In the meantime, here’s an crusty old Curious.
